title: Tech Note: SVG Charts in 4D v11 SQL
author: Christopher Visaya, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note documents 4D v11 SQL's newly native SVG rendering support, letting the GRAPH command draw vector-based charts directly into a picture variable instead of relying solely on the older 4D Chart plug-in. SVG itself is a mature, still-current web standard, and the GRAPH/GRAPH SETTINGS commands persisted in 4D for a long time, but this note's exact code patterns and the 4D Chart plug-in comparison reflect a 2007-era charting toolset that has since been joined or partly superseded by newer charting and reporting approaches in current 4D and web-based visualization libraries.
related_updates: 4D's GRAPH/GRAPH SETTINGS commands and SVG-based charting have continued to be available in 4D for many years after this note, though 4D's charting/reporting options have expanded since 2007
The older 4D Chart plug-in referenced as an alternative in this note is a legacy component from that era
